name: Subtle Substring Subtraction
justification: One killer observation (Alice grabs almost everything turn one); output format 'Name diff' is unambiguous but two-token.
solution_sketch: If |s| is even Alice takes the whole string. If odd, she takes everything except the cheaper end character, which Bob then takes. Diff = total - 2*min(s[0], s[-1]); Bob wins only for |s|=1.
